0022600165.text: The Grizzlies, 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the 2-4 Pelicans, who are 11th in the West and 4 games back in the Southwest, as Memphis looks for its seventh straight win and a perfect start to its season. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Memphis's last game against New Orleans was a 114-106 loss in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
